style_brief.brand_voice: Tenacity Volleyball Club speaks with a warm, community-rooted pride centered on developing Western Wisconsin youth athletes both on and off the court. The tone is encouraging and aspirational — emphasizing core values of teamwork, determination, respect, and a growth mindset — while staying practical and parent-friendly for registration, recruiting, and season logistics. It reads like a tight-knit family program celebrating its players' achievements and championing their dreams of playing collegiate volleyball.
layout_conventions: Lead landing and identity pages with the club mission statement set as a prominent intro quote
Use the recurring tagline 'Local. Athlete. Support. Passion.' as a divider/banner accent where it appears in the body
Render achievement and recognition pages as season-grouped heading + list sections followed by a photo gallery
Treat clusters of action images/logos with links (registration, recruiting tools, documents) as CTA card grids
Render sponsor/affiliate repetitions as a sponsor strip rather than duplicated paragraphs
Place the contact card with phone and social links at the bottom of primary pages
Keep thin pages thin — single intro paragraph plus its supporting image or link, no padding

blocks.source_brief: Section heading for the Badger Region HP All-Star program

props.body:
Badger Region High-Performance program is a part of the regional branches of USA Volleyball's National Team Development Program.

Badger Region HP Programs are operated by the USAV Region which sponsors the program to provide junior athletes with high-level training and skill development with some of the top coaches in that region. This is a great opportunity for athletes to compete nationwide at the highest-level international junior tournament available in the United States.

Athletes must tryout to participate in this training camp hosted by the Badger Region. They will select only a few from each age group. After the tryouts, they will take part in this training camp, where athletes will be selected to be a part of the Badger Region HP Championship team. They will then compete at a USA All-Star Championship tournament.

blocks.source_brief: 'FACTS & QUESTIONS' page heading

props.title: What is Club Volleyball?
props.body: Club volleyball is an opportunity to play volleyball outside of high or middle school ball. The players will be a part of an organization that will arrange for team practices, coaches, uniforms, and tournaments. Tenacity season starts in November and goes until March. We will have teams ranging from 12s to 17s level of play.

children.source_brief: FAQ entry: What is Club Volleyball?
children.source_quote: Club volleyball is an opportunity to play volleyball outside of high or middle school ball. The players will be a part of an organization that will arrange for team practices, coaches, uniforms, and tournaments.

props.title: What is Badger Region?
props.body: Badger Region is a nonprofit membership organization dedicated to providing a high-quality volleyball experience to its members. Badger is one of the 40 regions of USA Volleyball. Badger is the Wisconsin chapter of USA Volleyball and the premier volleyball authority in the state. Tenacity is a Badger-sanctioned club. We must follow all rules set by Badger.
